name: The Ritz-Carlton, Abama
positioning: Resort on a 160-hectare estate on Tenerife's southwest coast, officially The Ritz-Carlton Tenerife, Abama, with access to Abama Beach, The Retreat casitas and several restaurants
best_for: Travelers who want a private pool terrace in the Imperial Suite
Families wanting a kids club for ages 4 to 12
Guests who want direct access to Abama Beach

facts.text: The resort sits on a 160-hectare estate on the southwest coast of Tenerife in Guia de Isora.
The Del Mar Infinity pool is reserved for guests staying at The Retreat.
The Imperial Suite has a large outdoor terrace with its own private swimming pool.
The Royal Suites are on the 7th and 8th floors of the Citadel and each has two bedrooms.
Guests have a dedicated area with sunbeds and umbrellas at Abama Beach, complimentary and subject to availability.
Akira Back Tenerife brings chef Akira Back's cooking to Spain for the first time.
The Beach Club restaurant is on the sand of Abama Beach, with views of La Gomera.
The Serenity Pool welcomes guests aged 13 and above and overlooks the Abama golf course.
The Ritz Kids club runs daily activities for children aged 4 to 12.
A championship golf course overlooking the Atlantic Ocean and La Gomera is available to guests.

highlights.text: The Retreat is made up of four lanes of two-story casitas set against the hillside among subtropical gardens.
A private train takes guests down to the beach.
The rooms and suites draw on the heritage of the Guanches, the ancient indigenous people of Tenerife, and on the island's volcanic landscapes and gardens.
M.B is led by Chef Erlantz Gorostiza under the vision of Martín Berasategui.
Verde Mar serves a farm-to-table menu built on local produce and guided by the seasons.

considerations.text: Hotel guests without a spa treatment can use the spa water facilities for a 25 € entrance fee.
Guests of the spa must be at least 18 years old to have spa treatments.
Pool opening days and times may vary according to seasonality.
